description: Replay judge rule pack (Phase 4, judge side). `primitives` is a byte-identical copy of claims/replay/schema_replay_v1.json; `supplementary_primitives` is empty (the frozen file declares every primitive the judge reads); `derived` opens with the two rule-less stubs the exporter carries (mutant_killed_in, op_qualified_rt), byte-identical to replay_facts._DERIVED_TARGET_DECLS so combine() accepts both, then the reviewed program; `rules` are in raw IR JSON wire form. op_qualified(index, run, op) is the only claim relation and the only static/runtime join, witnessed by index_describes_replay.
